A convolution slides a small kernel over.zh: 卷积将一个小型核沿序列滑动。若令其成为@@T0@@因果@@T1@@ 卷积，它便被禁止窥视未来：时刻 $t$ 的输出只能触及 $t$ 及其之前的输入。再加上@@T2@@左侧填充@@T3@@ 以保持长度不变，并用@@T4@@膨胀@@T5@@ 在不额外增加任何权重的情况下看得更远的过去。拖动下方的核，观察这些规则如何自我约束。
A convolution slides a small kernel over.src: A convolution slides a small kernel over a sequence. Make it causal and it is forbidden from peeking into the future: the output at time $t$ may only touch inputs at $t$ and earlier. Add left-padding to keep the length intact, and dilation to see far into the past without spending a single extra weight. Drag the kernel below and watch the rules enforce themselves.

@@T0@@~8 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 8 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 序列模型 · TCN / WaveNet@@T3@@
@@T0@@~8 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.src: ~8 min Deep Learning · Sequence Models · TCN / WaveNet

One kernel, one rule: no looking ahead.zh: 一个核，一条规则：不得前瞻
One kernel, one rule: no looking ahead.src: One kernel, one rule: no looking ahead

A 1-D convolution with kernel size $K$ c.zh: 核大小为 $K$ 的一维卷积将每个输出计算为 $K$ 个相邻输入的加权和。在普通卷积中，这些相邻输入跨越当前位置 — 其中一些位于未来。对流式数据（音频、文本、预测）而言这便是作弊：在时刻 $t$，你根本还没有 $x[t+1]$。@@T0@@因果@@T1@@ 卷积固定窗口，使每一个抽头都落在当下或过去：
A 1-D convolution with kernel size $K$ c.src: A 1-D convolution with kernel size $K$ computes each output as a weighted sum of $K$ neighbouring inputs. In a plain conv those neighbours straddle the current position — some are in the future. For streaming data (audio, text, forecasts) that is cheating: at time $t$ you simply do not have $x[t+1]$ yet. A causal convolution fixes the window so every tap lands on the present or the past:

Here $d$ is the @@T0@@dilation@@T1@@: th.zh: 其中 $d$ 为@@T0@@膨胀率@@T1@@：抽头之间的步长。当 $d=1$ 时抽头相邻；当 $d>1$ 时它们彼此散开、留下空隙，使核得以用完全相同的 $K$ 个权重回溯到更早的时间。单个输出所能看到的输入跨度即其@@T2@@感受野@@T3@@，为 $(K-1)\,d + 1$。
Here $d$ is the @@T0@@dilation@@T1@@: th.src: Here $d$ is the dilation: the stride between taps. With $d=1$ the taps are adjacent; with $d>1$ they spread out, opening holes so the kernel reaches further back in time using the exact same $K$ weights. The stretch of input a single output can see is its receptive field, $(K-1)\,d + 1$.

Slide the kernel across the sequence.src: Slide the kernel across the sequence

The top row is the input sequence $x$; t.zh: 上行为输入序列 $x$；下行为输出 $y$。橙色虚线为@@T0@@当前时刻@@T1@@ — 即当前时间 $t$。其右侧的一切都是被阴影遮蔽的@@T2@@未来@@T3@@，对因果核而言属于禁地。蓝框单元格是馈入当前输出的 $K$ 个抽头。移动@@T4@@当前时刻@@T5@@、调整核的大小、拉伸膨胀率，并切换左侧填充。
The top row is the input sequence $x$; t.src: The top row is the input sequence $x$; the bottom row is the output $y$. The dashed orange line is now — the current time $t$. Everything to its right is the shaded future, off-limits to a causal kernel. The blue-outlined cells are the $K$ taps feeding the current output. Move now, resize the kernel, stretch the dilation, and toggle left-padding.

Causal 1-D convolution. Output $y[t]$ re.zh: 因果一维卷积。输出 $y[t]$ 只读取 $t, t-d, \dots, t-(K{-}1)d$ 处的抽头 — 从不跨越@@T0@@当前时刻@@T1@@ 这条线。
Causal 1-D convolution. Output $y[t]$ re.src: Causal 1-D convolution. Output $y[t]$ reads only taps at $t, t-d, \dots, t-(K{-}1)d$ — never across the now line.

@@T0@@@@T1@@@@T2@@ kernel tap@@T3@@\n.src: kernel tap current output padding zero future (masked)

@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@ Turn left-padding.zh: @@T0@@试一试。@@T1@@ 将左侧填充@@T2@@关闭@@T3@@，并把@@T4@@当前时刻@@T5@@ 拖到最左端。核最旧的抽头会从序列边缘掉落（以橙色标出）— 那里没有 $x[-1]$ 可读，因此无法产生输出。这正是输出比输入短的原因，也是下方缺失的左侧单元格被置灰的原因。
@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@ Turn left-padding.src: Try this. Turn left-padding off and drag now to the far left. The kernel's oldest taps fall off the edge of the sequence (marked in orange) — there is no $x[-1]$ to read, so no output can be produced there. That is exactly why the output is shorter than the input, and why the missing left cells are greyed out below.

Why dilation is the whole trick.zh: 为何膨胀率才是关键所在
Why dilation is the whole trick.src: Why dilation is the whole trick

Push the dilation slider from $1$ to $4$.zh: 将膨胀率滑块从 $1$ 推到 $4$，并保持核大小固定为 $K=3$。核仍然只有三个权重 — 但其感受野从 $3$ 跃升至 $9$。将若干这样的层以膨胀率 $1, 2, 4, 8, \dots$ 堆叠起来，感受野便随深度呈@@T0@@指数@@T1@@ 增长，而参数数量仅线性增长。这正是 WaveNet 与时间卷积网络（TCN）背后的引擎。
Push the dilation slider from $1$ to $4$.src: Push the dilation slider from $1$ to $4$ and keep the kernel size fixed at $K=3$. The kernel still has only three weights — but its receptive field leaps from $3$ to $9$. Stack a handful of such layers with dilations $1, 2, 4, 8, \dots$ and the receptive field grows exponentially with depth while the parameter count grows only linearly. This is the engine behind WaveNet and Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs).

@@T0@@Causality@@T1@@ is a masking rule,.zh: @@T0@@因果性@@T1@@ 是一条掩蔽规则，而非一种新运算：禁止任何下标 $> t$ 的抽头。它使卷积模型能够诚实地对数据流建模。
@@T0@@Causality@@T1@@ is a masking rule,.src: Causality is a masking rule, not a new operation: forbid any tap with index $> t$. It lets a conv model streaming data honestly.

@@T0@@Left-padding@@T1@@ of $(K{-}1)d$ z.zh: @@T0@@左侧填充@@T1@@ 的 $(K{-}1)d$ 个零可恢复长度，使输出与输入一一对齐 — 这对层与层的堆叠至关重要。
@@T0@@Left-padding@@T1@@ of $(K{-}1)d$ z.src: Left-padding of $(K{-}1)d$ zeros restores the length so the output lines up one-to-one with the input — essential for stacking layers.

@@T0@@Dilation@@T1@@ buys reach for free.zh: @@T0@@膨胀率@@T1@@ 免费换来触及范围：同样的 $K$ 个权重，以 $d$ 为间隔，覆盖 $(K{-}1)d+1$ 个时间步。
@@T0@@Dilation@@T1@@ buys reach for free.src: Dilation buys reach for free: the same $K$ weights, spaced $d$ apart, cover $(K{-}1)d+1$ timesteps.

@@T0@@Connect it up.@@T1@@ A causal conv.zh: @@T0@@建立联系。@@T1@@ 因果卷积是 RNN 在卷积一侧的表亲：二者都尊重时间之矢来处理序列。但 RNN 必须逐步展开，而一叠膨胀因果卷积则能并行地看到全部过去 — 这正是 TCN 在同一预测任务上往往比循环模型训练更快的原因。
@@T0@@Connect it up.@@T1@@ A causal conv.src: Connect it up. A causal conv is the convolutional cousin of an RNN: both process a sequence respecting time's arrow. But where an RNN must unroll step by step, a stack of dilated causal convs sees the whole past in parallel — which is why TCNs often train faster than recurrent models on the same forecasting task.

meta.title: 因果卷积
meta.tagline: 让核沿序列滑动，绝不窥视未来 —— 左侧填充与膨胀率是仅有的两个关键旋钮
meta.summary: 在序列上拖动一个因果一维卷积，观察规则如何自我约束：时刻 t 的核只能触及 t 及其之前的输入，故被阴影遮蔽的未来始终不可涉足。切换左侧填充可使输出长度与输入保持一致，拉伸膨胀率可在不增加任何权重的前提下将感受野扩大至 (K-1)d+1。这正是 WaveNet 与时间卷积网络背后的构件，在此变得可触可感。
highlights: 将因果性视为一条掩蔽规则来观察：核在物理上被阻止越过“当前时刻”这条线进入阴影中的未来。
切换左侧填充，观察输出长度如何从 N-(K-1)d 骤然回到 N，并以填充零补齐缺失的过去。
将膨胀率从 1 拉伸到 4，观察感受野 (K-1)d+1 如何增大，而权重数量始终固定为 K。
在关闭填充的情况下把“当前时刻”滑到最左端，观察最旧的抽头如何从边缘掉落 —— 没有 x[-1]，就没有输出。
直接关联到 WaveNet 与 TCN，其中膨胀率 1,2,4,8 给出指数增长感受野。
